_comment: Bundle budgets checked by scripts/bundle-report.mjs (GMR-53). PROPOSED defaults, not canon. Raise only with evidence and a canon update. Sizes in kilobytes (1 KB = 1024 B). GMR-99 (slim Phaser build) measured 204.3 KB initial JS gzip and 816.8 KB total. Re-based 2026-10-08 after the vertical-slice features landed (game flow, save, checkpoints, patroller goon, racing timing and PB ghost): measured 234.1 KB initial JS gzip and 948.3 KB total, budgets are those plus ~15% headroom again. Re-based again 2026-10-12 for section 2 (hero head sprites, generative music, telemetry, timed/one-use anchors, level 2-1, terrain kit 0017, key remapping): measured 271.8 KB initial JS gzip and 1111.2 KB total with PRs #61 and #70 applied; budgets are those plus ~10% headroom. Phaser is ~90% of the main chunk. Next step if it keeps growing: lazy-load level data and dev tools out of the main chunk (GMR-36 load budget).
_totalNote: totalKB counts everything in dist/ except *.map files (raw bytes).
